title: Oh My Pi Model Configuration
description: Oh My Pi keeps its models in ~/.omp/agent/models.yml. This block lists the Ollama provider and the llama3.2 model it serves.

steps.description: This is Oh My Pi's model file, `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`. The page says Oh My Pi keeps its models here, listing the providers and the models each one serves.
The `providers` map holds `ollama`. `baseUrl` is `http://localhost:11434/v1`, `api` is `openai-completions`, and `auth` is none.
`models` lists one entry, `llama3.2`, with `reasoning` false, `input` as text, a `contextWindow` of 16384, and `maxTokens` of 4096.

steps.question: The page says on Route A you run which export first, because your home directory disappears when the container exits?
